pieces.title: 46 data-center questions were on local ballots in ten states on November 3. Of the 44 with a count, voters took the side that limits data centers in 43. Ohio had 21 of the questions, in 18 places, and the limiting side won all 21.
pieces.line: The one exception was the City of Harwood, North Dakota, where a review requirement failed 105 to 325; two Maine towns had no count yet, and every count stays unofficial until the canvasses close.

pieces.title: Eleven school tax questions went to voters in four counties around Cincinnati on November 3: all six earned-income taxes failed, and three of five property questions passed, Cincinnati Public's 7 mills, Sycamore's 6.95 and Lakota's $223 million bond by 1,461 votes.
pieces.line: Winton Woods' 6.95-mill levy and Bethel-Tate's renewal failed; the counts are the county boards' election-night totals and stay unofficial until the canvass closes November 24.

pieces.title: The office that audits every local government in Ohio went offline Sunday. The counties it audits run on the same kinds of vendor systems, and the state counts more than 150 local cyber incidents in three years.
pieces.line: The Ohio Auditor of State says the attack was not ransomware and the data is intact; the method is not public. Butler County's property search went dark for days in 2024, and state law now requires a cyber program in every county and seals the record of it.

pieces.title: PHP fixed two flaws that let anyone on the internet run commands on a website’s server. Cloudflare saw millions of attempts within 12 hours of the fix.
pieces.line: Cloudflare's CEO posted that attempts went from thousands before the fix to millions by that night. No source on the record confirms a break-in; the fix has to be installed on each server.

pieces.title: Anthropic pledges 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund. Elon Musk pledges one SpaceX share to every kid in America.
pieces.line: Anthropic's fund needs a stockholder vote first. Musk's gift is set for next year; Musk has given no details on how. Neither has a date for the first share to move.

pieces.title: Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT. They say it was marketed as safe while designed to agree with its users.
pieces.line: On October 14 the attorneys general of Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia each sued OpenAI in their own state courts; the complaints, the asks, the timeline and what a judge could order, from the record.

pieces.title: 3,000 of Kroger's 8,200 corporate jobs will be cut. Over three years, citing technology.
pieces.line: Kroger, the company behind 2,697 supermarkets from Cincinnati to Los Angeles, told staff on October 12 that about 3,000 of its 8,200 corporate jobs will be cut over three years.
